# ScummVM (web build)

`tools/build_scummvm.sh` compiles ScummVM (https://www.scummvm.org) to WebAssembly with its official
Emscripten port and copies `scummvm.js`, `scummvm.wasm` and `data/` (themes, engine data, plugins) here.

https://github.com/scummvm/scummvm/blob/master/COPYING
The files are distributed unmodified. Version and engines: see `VERSION` and `ENGINES` once built.
